'''Settlement Garrisons''' specifies the baseline defensive garrisons and militia strengths assigned to all fortifications in ''Realms of Dust''.  == Defense Rationale == Completely empty fortifications invite game-breaking vulnerabilities where wandering bandits or micro-parties can seize cities without siege equipment. To solve this, all fortifications start with a standardized '''Skeleton Watch'''.  == Baseline Garrison Strengths == * '''Capitals (Towns):''' Exactly '''20 Tier-1 Garrison Troops''' ** 10 Tier-1 Infantry / Melee Guards ** 10 Tier-1 Ranged / Archer Guards ** Civic baseline: 70 Loyalty, 60 Security * '''Strongholds (Castles):''' Exactly '''15 Tier-1 Garrison Troops''' ** 8 Tier-1 Infantry / Melee Guards ** 7 Tier-1 Ranged / Archer Guards ** Civic baseline: 70 Loyalty, 60 Security * '''Frontier Strongholds:''' Exactly '''15 Tier-1 Neutral Guards'''  == Settlement Militia == In addition to the formal garrison watch, settlements maintain their baseline civic militia: * '''Town Militia:''' Approximately 30?40 local armed citizens. * '''Castle Militia:''' Approximately 20?25 local hearth defenders. * '''Militia Rules:''' Civic militia never leave the settlement walls and cannot be recruited into mobile field armies. They mobilize strictly when an active siege assault breaches or ladders the walls.
